sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: A Rallied creature may consume Rallied before rolling its next Action or Reaction to gain 1 free die on that card. The free die can exceed the normal maximum but does not satisfy the card's minimum commitment.

sections.label: DURATION
sections.html: Rallied expires at the end of the recipient's next Turn if unused. Reapplication refreshes or extends duration without shortening the time remaining and never banks several free dice. Rallied grants no extra Action, illegal Reaction, or Resource restoration.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
